Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the MAP draft — we've reviewed with our procurement and legal teams. Two quick asks to help us align internal approval:

2) We need a firm start date to plan inventory and training — our ideal day-one is 2026-09-01 but procurement may request a short buffer.

I've attached our internal PO template and a short list of signers from Stellar. Legal flagged two small items (data retention paragraph + audit log SLA) which your legal team had previously acknowledged.

Can we lock the signing window to at least 48 hours so our internal approvers can escalate?

Thanks,

Elena — thanks for the note and for sharing the PO template. Quick status from our side:

- Executive approval: Kimberly Park (VP, Commercial Ops) will own exec sign-off on the Redwood side and will be the single escalation contact for any last-minute questions.
- Esign window: we typically recommend a 48–72 hour DocuSign window for enterprise signers; we can open a 72-hour envelope to give both teams breathing room.
- Legal items: Camila has confirmed the retention and audit language are acceptable with the retention addendum attached to the MAP.
- Onboarding / start date: we can target 2026-09-01 provided the signed agreement and PO are in hand by 2026-08-30 (two business days prior to start to confirm infra provisioning).

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll generate the final Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf with the retention addendum and send a DocuSign envelope to the two Stellar signers.
- Please confirm the Stellar signers and whether procurement will send a PO or if you want us to raise an invoice after signing.

Kimberly / Camila — tagging you to confirm you can approve the final DocuSign envelope and sign by 2026-08-30 if everything looks correct.

Thanks,
Rishi
